content.content: 1. Necessity: scopelessness needs the listing promise for the view it bounds — without it, settling nothing is motiveless. Fail if the edge can be dropped without loss. 2. License: no element of the elaboration contradicts the parent. Fail on any contradicting element — name the element.
content.rationale: Scope is where the boundary meets the listing; the gate keeps the use sound without testing query semantics itself.
